Our Story

About The Academy

Purani Cricket Academy is the premier cricket training center in Rajpipla, Gujarat. Founded with a passion for the sport, we have nurtured young cricketers into disciplined, skilled athletes ready for district and state-level competition.

Our state-of-the-art training facilities, expert coaching panel led by Rajendra Singh Tanwar, and holistic development approach set us apart from every other academy in the region.

Rajendra Singh Tanwar
⭐ Head Coach & Founder – Purani Cricket Academy

Rajendra Singh Tanwar is the heart and soul of Purani Cricket Academy. With over 2 years of dedicated coaching experience, he brings a unique blend of technical expertise, strategic insight, and motivational leadership to every training session. Under his guidance, countless players have gone on to represent Rajpipla at the district and state level.

Dr. Tanvir Mam

Dr. Tanvir Mam
⭐ Cricket Expert & Mentor – Purani Cricket Academy

Dr. Tanvir Mam is the dedicated Women's Cricket Coach at Purani Cricket Academy, Rajpipla. She has been instrumental in building a strong women's cricket program, training girls from age 9+ in batting, bowling, and fielding with passion and expertise. Her coaching style focuses on discipline, teamwork, and technical excellence.
